column2: aptus Philippines brief target 2, file 3 of 3 — Philippine tax account assignment
SAP Best Practices 2608 account master data for the YCOA template chart of accounts

NO HARVEST WAS NEEDED for this file. The sheet is multi-country: it carries a Country column (LAND1) with 66 countries, and 22 Philippine rows sit beside the 59 Malaysian rows WS11 loaded. The workbook is already in the repository.
complete for this source: every row of the T030K sheet with Country = PH was taken, 22 of them.

this is the tax account assignment SAP publishes in the TEMPLATE chart workbook. The Malaysian LOCAL workbook (..._YCOA_MY.xlsx) also carries a T030K sheet; its Philippine counterpart is not in the repository, so a PH local variant of this table, if SAP publishes one, is not represented here.

transaction_key="Transaction Keys" (KTOSL) · tax_code="Tax Code" (MWSKZ) · gl_account="G/L account" (KONTS) · description="Description", all verbatim. country_variant is the sheet's Country (LAND1) column, which reads PH on every row of this file.
0 of 22 rows carry no tax code — SAP publishes those assignments as tax-code-independent. The cell is left empty, never filled.

the sheet also publishes a second G/L account column (KONTH, the credit-side account). The brief fixes a single gl_account column, so KONTH is not in this file; it is in the workbook at the path above.
a blank cell means the workbook publishes nothing there.
